name: Ed's Agentic Finance Rails
description: Payments and personal money agents: one record per program, protocol or tool. Values are sourced or 'unknown'.

programs.title: AgentBank
programs.summary: An MCP server that lets an AI agent collect, hold, convert and send money, including to bank accounts in local currency, using crypto rails. The owner confirms every payment, and an approval threshold adds an extra check.
programs.operator: AgentBank, operated by Thinking Horizon, Inc.
programs.agent_can: Collect payments, convert between currencies and crypto assets, pay bank, QR or wallet recipients in local currency, and pay x402 services, through an MCP server
programs.user_controls: The owner confirms the recipient, amounts, fees and expiry of every payment before it is created. An approval threshold sets when a payment needs an extra approval. ChatGPT and Claude connections can also have a spending limit, and the owner can disconnect an agent at any time
programs.availability: unknown

programs.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
programs.summary: AWS service that lets an agent pay for APIs, MCP servers and content over x402 and MPP within a per-session budget. Since 2026-11-19 it can also pay AWS Marketplace sellers in US dollars on the AWS bill, with no crypto wallet.
programs.agent_can: Pay for paid APIs, MCP servers and web content over x402 and the Machine Payments Protocol, through a configured wallet provider, and pay x402-enabled AWS Marketplace sellers per request in US dollars on the AWS bill
programs.user_controls: Each payment session has a budget limit and an expiry, and further payments are denied once either is reached. Developers can also set spending limits and approved sellers with AgentCore policy, and AWS Marketplace purchases appear in AWS CloudTrail and AWS Cost Explorer
programs.availability: Generally available since August 2026. AWS Marketplace payments are available in all AWS Regions where AgentCore payments is available, and the list of Regions is unknown

programs.title: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
programs.summary: An open standard for buyers, their AI agents and businesses to complete purchases. OpenAI and Stripe maintain the spec, which is in beta.
programs.agent_can: Let a user find and buy from a business inside an AI app, through a checkout API and a delegated-payment spec
programs.user_controls: unknown
programs.availability: Beta. OpenAI and Stripe were the first to implement it

programs.title: AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)
programs.summary: An open protocol that records what a user authorized an agent to buy as signed mandates: a Checkout Mandate for the merchant, a Payment Mandate for payment.
programs.agent_can: Carry signed proof of what the user authorized: a Checkout Mandate shared with the merchant and a Payment Mandate shared with the credential provider, the card networks and the payment processor
programs.user_controls: Open mandates hold the user's limits, such as budget and allowed payment methods, before a cart is final. Closed mandates authorize one finalized checkout and amount
programs.availability: Open protocol, available as an extension for A2A and Universal Commerce Protocol. Samples in Python, Go and Android

programs.title: ChatGPT Wallet
programs.summary: OpenAI's wallet that lets an agent in ChatGPT pay for you. You approve each purchase with a biometric check, and the card network supplies a payment token so the agent and merchant never see your real card number.
programs.operator: OpenAI, built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa
programs.agent_can: Complete a purchase at a merchant's normal checkout with a one-purchase payment token, after you approve it
programs.user_controls: You review the items, total and card, then approve each purchase with a biometric check such as Face ID. The terms also allow granting ChatGPT authority to approve purchases in advance
programs.availability: Rolling out from 2026-11-13 in dots, to ChatGPT Pro users in the US aged 18 or older with eligible US-issued American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa cards

programs.title: Lightspark Agent Accounts
programs.summary: Lightspark accounts where an AI agent holds, spends, sends and receives money within limits and approvals the account holder sets. It pays Visa merchants with a card valid for one purchase. Sold to companies that build agents.
programs.agent_can: Hold, spend, send and receive money for a person or business, pay a merchant that accepts Visa with a card valid for that purchase alone or a saved card seen only as a card ID, and settle directly with a merchant that has an Agent Account
programs.user_controls: The account holder sets spending limits and decides which payments need their approval. The customer authorizes a delegated key once and can pause the agent, revoke the key or delete the agent at any time
programs.availability: Launched 2026-11-17 for companies building agents for consumers, small businesses and merchants. The Agents API must be enabled for each platform

programs.title: Link wallet for agents
programs.summary: Stripe's Link wallet for agents lets a person approve each purchase an agent makes, with a one-time card or shared payment token. Muse, Grok Bot, Instinct and Claude Duet use Link or a wallet like it.
programs.agent_can: Create a spend request in a person's Link wallet to get a one-time-use card or a shared payment token for a purchase, scoped by amount, currency and merchant. Stripe says Link can also tell an agent how to continue, such as a 3D Secure link, and an agent can ask for a higher approved amount
programs.user_controls: The person grants wallet access through OAuth and approves each spend request in Link on web, iOS or Android. They can track agent spending and manage connected agents in Link. Stripe plans spending limits and a way to let agents act without approving each purchase, with no date given
programs.availability: Stripe announced Link's wallet for agents on 2026-04-29. Its 2026-09-08 release says US consumers can connect Link to Muse, and its 2026-09-29 post says Muse is the first agent to offer Link purchase protections

programs.title: Mastercard Agent Pay
programs.summary: Mastercard's program for agent payments. Agents are registered and verified before they can pay, and they pay with agentic tokens. Merchants can verify agents with Web Bot Auth.
programs.agent_can: Pay with agentic tokens once registered and verified, including through a merchant's normal card checkout form
programs.user_controls: Mastercard says each transaction is checked against authenticated user intent and explicit consent before the action
programs.availability: unknown

programs.title: PayPal
programs.summary: PayPal offers an MCP server, run locally or hosted, and an agent toolkit that let AI agents use PayPal business APIs such as orders, invoices, subscriptions and disputes.
programs.agent_can: Use PayPal APIs for orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details and disputes
programs.user_controls: Access uses the PayPal account's own credentials: an access token for the local server, or client ID and secret for the hosted one. A sandbox is available for testing
programs.availability: Local server (Node.js 18 or later) or hosted server. Sandbox address https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com

programs.title: Rain Agent Vaults
programs.summary: Rain's funded balance for AI agents. The owner funds a vault and sets rules, and the agent pays with a single-use virtual Visa or Mastercard card issued for each purchase. Sold to companies that build agents.
programs.agent_can: Spend from a funded vault with a scoped virtual card issued for each purchase, send money to bank accounts in local currency, and send stablecoins
programs.user_controls: The vault owner sets the rules, such as how much the agent can spend, which merchants it can pay and when. Each card's amount, merchant and expiry are fixed when it is issued, and the agent cannot raise its own limit
programs.availability: Announced 2026-11-10 for companies and developers building agents, through Rain's sales team

programs.title: Robinhood Agentic Credit Card
programs.summary: A virtual card inside the Robinhood Gold Card that your AI agent uses through the Robinhood Banking MCP. You approve each purchase or set a required monthly limit.
programs.agent_can: Fetch the agentic virtual card's number to finish purchases, and read that card's spending history and settings. The MCP does not browse or shop for you
programs.user_controls: Approve each purchase in the Robinhood Banking app, or set a monthly limit, which is required if you do not approve each purchase. The agent sees only the cards you authorize
programs.availability: A virtual card in the Robinhood Gold Card. Card setup and agent sign-in work on desktop only. Announced 2026-05-27

programs.title: Stripe
programs.summary: Stripe offers shared payment tokens, which give a seller scoped, time-limited use of a customer's payment method for agent purchases, plus an official MCP server at mcp.stripe.com.
programs.agent_can: Grant a seller a shared payment token for a purchase. Separately, call the Stripe API and search Stripe's docs through the Stripe MCP server
programs.user_controls: Each token has usage and expiry limits, such as currency, maximum amount and an expiry window. MCP access is granted on Stripe's OAuth consent page and can be revoked, and Stripe can require you to approve certain MCP actions in the Dashboard
programs.availability: Shared payment tokens are in public preview in the US, Canada and select European countries

programs.title: Visa Intelligent Commerce
programs.summary: Visa's agent payments program: approved agent builders get tokenized Visa credentials, network-level controls and consumer-approved purchase instructions.
programs.agent_can: Buy things for a consumer with tokenized Visa credentials, under purchase instructions the consumer approved
programs.user_controls: Consumer-approved purchase instructions, Visa Payment Passkeys with device binding, and network-level controls
programs.availability: Production needs Visa onboarding and approval at each stage: sandbox, certification, production. Intelligent Commerce Connect was in pilot with select partners as of 2026-04-08

programs.title: x402
programs.summary: An open payment standard built on HTTP 402 Payment Required: the server asks for payment inside the request, and the client pays and retries. Coinbase uses it.
programs.agent_can: Pay for a web resource as part of the request: the server replies 402 Payment Required with its terms, and the client retries with a payment attached
programs.user_controls: unknown
programs.availability: Open standard. Specification version 2 is published

programs.title: Finances in ChatGPT
programs.summary: Finances in ChatGPT reads your accounts through Plaid and credit reports through Experian, in the US. OpenAI says it cannot move money, pay bills, trade or change account settings.
programs.agent_can: Read balances, transactions, investments and liabilities from accounts connected through Plaid, and credit report data through Experian, to show a dashboard and answer questions. It cannot move money, pay bills, change account settings, make trades, change retirement contributions, open or close accounts or file taxes
programs.user_controls: You choose to connect each source, and Plaid and Experian are separate connections. You can disconnect Finances in Settings, which removes the connected data from ChatGPT, and view or delete financial memories. Temporary chats do not access connected accounts
programs.availability: In the US for Free, Go, Plus and Pro users on web, iOS and Android. Launched as a Pro preview on 2026-05-15, then Plus and Pro on 2026-06-25 and Free and Go from 2026-10-02

programs.title: Claude Duet
programs.summary: Claude Duet is Anthropic's proactive agent app, in research preview. It asks before it pays, sends or deletes, pays with a one-time Link card, and cannot trade or move money between accounts.
programs.agent_can: Work as a proactive agent with its own virtual machine and browser, across connected apps. For purchases it pays with a one-time card from a wallet like Link from Stripe, limited to that merchant and amount. Trading securities and banking actions such as moving money between accounts stay off-limits even with approval
programs.user_controls: It shows the action, destination and content and waits for approval before sending a sensitive message, paying or deleting, with a separate automated check running alongside. Paying or sending money cannot be covered by a don't-ask-again rule. You approve a purchase in your Link app
programs.availability: Research preview on iOS, Android and claude.ai, included in Pro, Max and Ultra plans. It starts with Pro, Max and Ultra users in the US, through a waitlist

programs.title: Claude Personal Finance
programs.summary: Claude's Personal Finance feature reads your balances and transactions from banks you link through Plaid, read-only. It cannot move, manage or invest money. It is in beta on paid US plans.
programs.agent_can: Read linked accounts through Plaid, read-only, to answer questions and build widgets, including account names, types and last four digits, up to 24 months of transactions, and balances and credit limits. It cannot move, manage or invest money
programs.user_controls: You sign in to your bank through Plaid and choose which accounts to share, and can link up to 16 banks. You can unlink a bank, turn the Plaid connector off or set it to ask before each read, and disconnect Claude at my.plaid.com. Claude asks before linking or unlinking a bank in a chat
programs.availability: In beta on Pro, Max and Ultra plans in the US only, on Claude web, desktop, iOS and Android. Not on Free, Team or Enterprise plans. Rolling out gradually

programs.title: Gemini with Google Wallet
programs.summary: Google's Gemini app can read your spending from Google Wallet and linked bank and card accounts to answer money questions. It is read-only and cannot move money.
programs.agent_can: Answer money questions from Google Wallet data and from bank, card, loan and investment accounts linked to Wallet through Plaid, such as spending charts, forgotten subscriptions, budgets, and rewards and offers on cards and passes. Read-only, it cannot move, manage or invest money
programs.user_controls: You choose whether to connect Wallet to Gemini and can turn the connection on or off at any time. You can unlink financial accounts in Google Wallet settings and manage Plaid connections in Plaid Portal
programs.availability: Rolling out from 2026-11-13 to Gemini app users in the US who are 18 or over, with a personal Google Account, in English, on the Gemini mobile and web apps. Google says it is being made available gradually

programs.title: Grok Bot
programs.summary: Grok Bot can read balances, spending and investments from accounts you link through Plaid, read-only. It can also pay with a Link one-time card or X Money, with a prompt to approve each purchase.
programs.agent_can: Through its Finance integration, answer questions about balances, spending, subscriptions and investments from bank, card and investment accounts linked through Plaid, read-only. Separately, pay at checkout with Stripe Link or X Money, with an approval step for each purchase
programs.user_controls: You choose whether to link accounts and can unlink them anytime. A financial connection is read-only. A Link purchase shows the amount to Allow or Deny, and every X Money action that moves money needs its own approval. After a bank or brokerage connector returns data, the Bot asks before sharing it anywhere else
programs.availability: The Finance integration was announced on 2026-09-26 and needs Grok Bot 0.49 or newer. Plans and regions for it are unknown

programs.title: Instinct
programs.summary: Instinct is a personal assistant that works in iMessage and WhatsApp. Plaid says it powers read-only account connections for US users, and Stripe says Link helps power its payments.
programs.agent_can: Read balances and transactions from accounts connected through Plaid, read-only, alongside connections such as email and calendar, to spot patterns and flag what needs attention. Stripe says Link's agent wallet helps power its payments
programs.user_controls: You authenticate your accounts through Plaid when Instinct prompts you, and Plaid says Instinct asks for approval before taking next steps such as drafting a dispute
programs.availability: Plaid's post of 2026-11-18 says US consumers can connect accounts, with thousands of US users. CNBC describes Instinct as invitation-only

programs.title: JPMorgan Smart Cash
programs.summary: A JPMorgan Chase AI tool in a targeted pilot. Per a news report, it aims to predict a user's cash flow and move funds to maximize yield. Only a news source is cited.
programs.agent_can: Predict a user's cash flow and move funds to maximize yield, as the bank's CFO described it (news report)
programs.user_controls: unknown
programs.availability: A targeted pilot that began in the weeks before 2026-10-13 (news report)

programs.title: Meta Muse
programs.summary: Meta's personal AI agent. Its finance features use Plaid so people can connect bank, card, investment and mortgage accounts for personalized money guidance.
programs.agent_can: Give personalized money guidance from accounts you connect through Plaid, such as balances, transactions, investment holdings and mortgage information. Separately, with your approval each time, buy online using Link by Stripe or a card saved in its Secure Credential Store
programs.user_controls: You choose whether to connect accounts, and you can manage Plaid-powered connections in Plaid Portal. Muse always asks for your approval before completing a purchase, and you can disconnect a Connector at any time in Settings
programs.availability: Launched 2026-09-08 with Plaid-powered account connections in its finance features

programs.title: Nous
programs.summary: A UK household AI agent that tracks bills and subscriptions, switches providers and cancels services for you. You choose how much it decides on its own. It reads bank data through an FCA-regulated open banking provider but cannot move money.
programs.operator: Nous (Nous for your House Limited, England)
programs.agent_can: Track household bills and subscriptions, switch energy, broadband, mobile and car insurance providers, cancel subscriptions, and handle other household admin. It cannot move or transfer money
programs.user_controls: Choose a savings mode (Manual, Balanced or Freedom) for how much Nous decides on its own, and set and change its permissions at any time
programs.availability: Live in the UK for one address per household, with a free tier and a paid Premium tier

programs.title: OpenAI dots
programs.summary: OpenAI's dots are always-on agents with their own cloud computer. They can buy with a card saved on a merchant site after approval. Whether a dot can read your Finances data is unknown.
programs.agent_can: Work as an always-on agent on its own cloud computer, using plugins to connect to apps. A dot can buy with a card you saved on a merchant's website, with your approval, which may be given in advance when it specifically covers the purchase
programs.user_controls: Dots start with built-in rules for which actions need approval each time, which can be approved in advance and which need none. Custom Rules let you allow, require approval for, or block specific actions, and auto-review checks actions that could affect your accounts. Sensitive tasks such as changing a password stay with you, and you can pause a dot at any time
programs.availability: Announced 2026-09-29 and rolling out to Pro users aged 18 and over outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK, and to Business Premium users in supported regions. Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces get it by default from 2026-11-18 unless an admin opts out

programs.title: Perplexity Personal CFO
programs.summary: Perplexity lets people connect accounts through Plaid and ask about their own money, read-only. Plaid reports it in the US with Perplexity Computer and in 17 European countries as Personal CFO.
programs.agent_can: According to Plaid, answer questions about spending, subscriptions and balances from accounts connected through Plaid, and build tools such as a budget tracker, net worth view or debt payoff plan. Plaid says access is read-only
programs.user_controls: According to Plaid, you choose which accounts to share and access is read-only. In the EU, Plaid provides the connection as a regulated account information service through Plaid B.V.
programs.availability: According to Plaid, US users can connect accounts through Plaid, and Pro and Max users get Perplexity Computer features, from 2026-04-09. Plaid says people in 17 European countries can use Personal CFO from 2026-11-12

programs.title: Plaid MCP servers
programs.summary: Plaid's MCP servers are developer tools: a hosted Dashboard MCP for diagnostics and a local sandbox MCP. They do not give agents access to users' accounts.
programs.agent_can: Developer work only: production diagnostics and analytics for a Plaid customer's team, and a local sandbox MCP for building. No access to end users' accounts
programs.user_controls: The Dashboard MCP needs a Plaid OAuth token, and the team must be approved for Production access
programs.availability: The Dashboard MCP is under active development. Plaid says breaking changes may occur and support is limited

programs.title: Starling Assistant
programs.summary: Starling Bank's in-app AI assistant will set up payments from voice or text, and the customer approves each one with a tap. It reaches all retail customers by the end of 2026.
programs.agent_can: Set up a payment from a voice or text prompt such as "Pay the plumber £200", for the customer to approve. The assistant also analyses direct debits and subscriptions, builds personalised budgets and creates Spaces
programs.user_controls: The customer authorises each payment with a screen tap
programs.availability: Announced 2026-11-13 and rolling out to all retail customers by the end of 2026, so not yet available to everyone. Small business customers will soon get a similar feature for paying invoices, with no date given

programs.title: X Money
programs.summary: X Money is a US money account inside the X app, run by X Payments LLC with Cross River Bank. Through the Grok Bot plugin, an agent can read the balance and history, and send or pay with approval per action.
programs.operator: X Payments LLC, with Cross River Bank holding the deposit accounts
programs.agent_can: Through the Grok Bot plugin and X Money's hosted MCP server, view the balance and transaction history, use the X Money card for purchases, and send or request money with users on X. X Money decides which of these actions each account gets
programs.user_controls: Connect with a code or QR code approved with a passkey in the X Money app, and revoke at X > Money > Settings > Connections. Every action that moves money needs its own Approve or Cancel, X Money refuses calls that were not approved, agents have separate limits, and higher-risk transfers stay in the X app
programs.availability: Rolling out in the US since 2026-07-27, first to Premium and Premium+ subscribers. X's pages now say it is available to select users who are 18 or older and live in the 50 states or DC. Interest is not available in New York
